tasks.title: Register the realtime package in the workspace
tasks.description: Add realtime to the packages list in pnpm-workspace.yaml, keeping packages/* and every existing entry untouched.

tasks.title: Create the realtime package manifest
tasks.description: Create realtime/package.json with start, start:dev, start:prod, build, lint (--max-warnings=0), typecheck and test scripts mirroring server, and declare the dependencies at the pinned ranges from plan.json.

tasks.title: Create the strict TypeScript configuration
tasks.description: Create realtime/tsconfig.json and tsconfig.build.json with strict, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters and the same module settings server uses.

tasks.title: Create nest-cli and ESLint configuration
tasks.description: Create realtime/nest-cli.json and the flat realtime/eslint.config.mjs matching server's rules, so lint fails on a warning rather than reporting it.

tasks.title: Create the colocated Jest configuration
tasks.description: Create realtime/jest.config.cjs with rootDir src and testRegex .*\.spec\.ts$, matching CON-403's colocated shape.

tasks.title: Document the realtime environment variables
tasks.description: Create realtime/.env.example documenting REALTIME_PORT, JWT_ACCESS_SECRET, REDIS_URL, MONGO_URI, REALTIME_CORS_ORIGINS, LOG_LEVEL and NODE_ENV, with no value that works as a production default.

tasks.title: Create the multi-stage Dockerfile
tasks.description: Create realtime/Dockerfile as a multi-stage pnpm workspace build that produces a runnable image without the dev dependencies.

tasks.title: Create the service bootstrap
tasks.description: Create realtime/src/main.ts with the Express adapter, helmet(), the pino logger, enableShutdownHooks(), and a listener on REALTIME_PORT (default 4001) with no global path prefix, so /health/live is reachable as written.

tasks.title: Create the typed configuration module
tasks.description: Create realtime/src/config/ reading and validating every environment variable at boot, failing with the variable's name when a required one is missing, and never logging a value.

tasks.title: Create the structured logging module
tasks.description: Create realtime/src/logging/ with the same pino record shape, level resolution and redact list as server, copied rather than imported because CON-106 forbids the cross-app import, extended with token, accessToken and clinicId.

tasks.title: Wire the application module graph
tasks.description: Create realtime/src/app.module.ts importing config, logging, mongo, redis, auth, gateway, relay and health in an order where the logger exists before any module that logs during construction.

tasks.title: Create the liveness and readiness probes
tasks.description: Create realtime/src/health/ with GET /health/live returning 200 without consulting a dependency, and GET /health/ready reporting Redis and Mongo separately: 200 degraded when only Redis is down, 503 when Mongo is down.

tasks.title: Handle shutdown cleanly
tasks.description: On SIGTERM, stop accepting connections, close the Socket.IO server, quit the three Redis clients and exit inside the shutdown timeout.

tasks.title: Extract the token from the handshake
tasks.description: Read the access token from the Socket.IO handshake auth payload, falling back to an Authorization: Bearer header, treating both as untrusted input with a bounded length and no object coercion.

tasks.title: Verify the access token and refuse generically
tasks.description: Verify the token with JWT_ACCESS_SECRET using the same library family server signs with, enforce exp, and refuse with one generic UNAUTHORIZED reason for every failure mode before any room join.

tasks.title: Validate the token claims strictly
tasks.description: Validate the verified claims with a strict zod schema requiring sub, clinic_id and role, rejecting unknown or absent keys, and refuse the connection when they are missing.

tasks.title: Bind the connection to its scope and rooms
tasks.description: On acceptance, write { userId, clinicId, role, exp } to socket.data and join user:<userId> and clinic:<clinicId> server-side with no client involvement.

tasks.title: Constrain the room:join handler
tasks.description: Register a room:join handler that accepts only rooms derived from socket.data, refuses every other room without adding membership, and treats an own-room re-join as a no-op.

tasks.title: Disconnect the socket at token expiry
tasks.description: Arm a clamped timer at the token's exp that disconnects the socket at expiry, and clear it on disconnect. The clamp matters because setTimeout above 2^31-1 ms fires immediately.

tasks.title: Create the three Redis clients
tasks.description: Create the client factory: a normal pub client, a duplicated sub client in subscriber mode for the adapter, and a separate events subscriber, all lazyConnect with a capped retry strategy and no command error on reconnect.

tasks.title: Wire the Socket.IO Redis adapter
tasks.description: Attach @socket.io/redis-adapter with the pub/sub pair so a publish from any instance reaches clients connected to every instance.

tasks.title: Start and degrade correctly without Redis
tasks.description: Start and accept connections while Redis is unreachable, expose the adapter/Redis state to the readiness probe, and resume relaying when the adapter reconnects without restarting the process.

tasks.title: Subscribe to and relay riaya:events
tasks.description: Create realtime/src/relay/event-relay.service.ts subscribing to riaya:events: parse, validate against the shared schema, then emit the unchanged envelope under its own event name to clinic:<clinicId>.

tasks.title: Drop and log invalid events
tasks.description: On a parse or validation failure, drop the event and log a warning naming the channel and the failing field path, without throwing out of the handler so the process keeps running.

tasks.title: Drop events for clinics with no listeners
tasks.description: When a valid event names a clinic with no connected sockets, checked cluster-wide with fetchSockets() rather than against locally-known rooms, drop it and log at debug.

tasks.title: Bound the frame size
tasks.description: Set maxHttpBufferSize to 16 KB so an oversized frame is rejected by the transport without closing the connection.

tasks.title: Declare the realtime event schema
tasks.description: Create packages/shared/src/schemas/realtime.ts with the RealtimeEvent envelope (event, contractVersion literal 1, clinicId, occurredAt, payload) and strict payload schemas for appointment.created, appointment.cancelled, appointment.rescheduled and queue.updated, following the zod skill's no-side-effects and z.infer rules.

tasks.title: Export the contract from the shared entry point
tasks.description: Re-export the module from packages/shared/src/index.ts so consumers import from @riaya/shared and never from a deep path.

tasks.title: Keep the relay on the shared contract
tasks.description: Import the schema in the relay from @riaya/shared only, and confirm no event shape is re-declared under realtime/src.

tasks.title: Connect to MongoDB without modelling anything
tasks.description: Create realtime/src/database/mongo.module.ts with MongooseModule.forRootAsync reading MONGO_URI, serverSelectionTimeoutMS around 2 s, and no forFeature, @Schema or model anywhere in the package.

tasks.title: Report Mongo state without blocking boot
tasks.description: Connect asynchronously so an unreachable Mongo does not block bootstrap, and report connection readyState in the readiness probe while socket connections keep working.

tasks.title: Apply Helmet with HSTS
tasks.description: Apply Helmet to the HTTP surface with HSTS enabled outside local development.

tasks.title: Throttle connection attempts per IP
tasks.description: Throttle connection attempts per IP through the Socket.IO allowRequest hook using a fixed-window Redis counter with a process-local fallback, refusing over-limit attempts and never throwing out of the hook.

tasks.title: Configure the CORS allow-list
tasks.description: Configure the Socket.IO CORS allow-list from REALTIME_CORS_ORIGINS with no wildcard and no cookie credentials, since authentication is a bearer token in the handshake.

tasks.title: Confirm no collection and no raw Mongo access
tasks.description: Confirm no collection is declared, no Mongoose model is registered and no raw Mongo command is issued; the only Mongo interaction in the package is the connection itself.

tasks.title: Redact credentials from the log
tasks.description: Extend the redact list with the handshake token, the access token and the clinic claim, and confirm a rejected handshake logs the reason without the credential.

tasks.title: Add the realtime service to compose
tasks.description: Add a realtime service to docker-compose.yml that depends on the existing redis and mongo health checks and passes the variables from realtime/.env.example.

tasks.title: Add a dev:realtime root script
tasks.description: Add a dev:realtime script to the root package.json without changing the existing dev script, so pnpm dev still works on a machine without Redis and Mongo.

tasks.title: Run the package linter
tasks.description: Run pnpm --filter realtime lint and resolve every finding without disabling a rule.

tasks.title: Run the package typecheck
tasks.description: Run pnpm --filter realtime typecheck and resolve every error under strict mode.

tasks.title: Run the formatter check and governance validator
tasks.description: Run pnpm format:check and node .sdrive/scripts/validate-governance.js; both must pass.

tasks.title: Run the spec-to-code verification
tasks.description: Run pnpm sdrive verify realtime-service and account for every reported gap.

tasks.title: Manually confirm cross-instance delivery
tasks.description: With two instances started against the compose Redis, confirm a single publish to one clinic room reaches a client on each instance once.

tasks.title: Manually confirm the Redis-degraded path
tasks.description: With Redis stopped, confirm the service starts, /health/live returns 200 and /health/ready reports degraded naming Redis; then start Redis and confirm relay resumes without a restart.

tasks.title: Manually confirm the Mongo-down path
tasks.description: With Mongo stopped, confirm /health/ready returns 503 naming Mongo while socket connections still work.
